Definition: neuter of a presumed compound of G1909 and G318; (adverbially) on necessity, i.e. necessarily:--necessary.
BiblicalUsage: The council at Jerusalem writes that it seemed good to the Holy Ghost and to us to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things in Acts 15:28 — the few things that truly had to be kept.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the church does its best work when it lays down only what is necessary, and leaves the rest to conscience and grace.
RelatedPeople: James, Brother of Jesus; Simon Peter; Paul
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
